bug_semantics: The /api/images POST route (packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/api/imageUpload) declares access 'private' in route.json, but in EverShop 2.0.1 the route's middleware chain orders [context]multerFile (which runs multer and creates the target directory on disk with mkdirSync) before the [auth] middleware: the file-naming convention [context]multerFile[auth] makes multer+directory-creation execute in the 'context' phase while authentication executes in the 'auth' phase that follows. An unauthenticated request therefore causes multer to write attacker-supplied files (subject only to a permissive extension check) into arbitrary named subdirectories under the media path before the auth check ever runs, and the resulting 401 does not roll back the write — an unauthenticated user uploads files and creates directories (CWE-434).
flaw_origin: Commit a2f514ad10073fb9ae164446f30205086151c095 ("RESTful api implementation", 2023-01-03, author The Nguyen <6950941+treoden@users.noreply.github.com>) created the imageUpload API with the file [context]multerFile[auth].js, whose multer storage destination callback performs `mkdirSync(join(CONSTANTS.MEDIAPATH, (request.params[0] || '').replace(/\s/g, '-')), { recursive: true })` and whose filename callback persists `file.originalname` — i.e., the write/directory-creation side effect wired to execute before the [auth] phase. The parent tree (4e518e617b76928656936e0048da852229acf24e) lacks the whole imageUpload directory (cat-file -e fails). Later refactors (54fac86e 2021-era rename chain aside, the v2.0.x split into fileUpload/[context]multerFile[auth].js with getMulter) preserved the same phase ordering; the security fix fc224b57 renames exactly these files to [auth,validatePath]multerFile.js, putting auth first and proving the ordering was the flaw.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author and committer The Nguyen <6950941+treoden@users.noreply.github.com> (2023-01-03), message "RESTful api implementation"; no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or bot/AI identity anywhere on the object.
evidence: Advisory (CVE-2025-65844 / GHSA-c88j-gfxj-293x, upstream issue evershopcommerce/evershop#819): EverShop 2.0.1 allows an unauthenticated user to upload files and create directories within the /api/images endpoint; CWE-434.

Vulnerable state at tag v2.0.1: route.json declares {"methods":["POST"],"path":"/images/*","access":"private"}; the middleware chain is imageUpload/[context]multerFile[auth].js -> fileUpload/[context]multerFile[auth].js, which runs `upload.array('images', 20)` (multer) with a path filter but no auth, while the EverShop handler convention places [auth] after [context]; the global auth middleware packages/evershop/src/modules/auth/api/global/[getCurrentUser]auth.js only runs when reached and returns 401 — after multer has already written files and created directories.

Fix commit fc224b577c785897fb4ba67f9e408626c5d44ae9 (2025-11-02, The Nguyen, "Fix: [SECURITY] /api/images is publically accessible by default & Image upload validation is insufficient. #819"): renames [context]multerFile[auth].js -> [auth,validatePath]multerFile.js and [context]validatePath[multerFile].js -> validatePath.js in both fileUpload and imageUpload, moving authentication and path validation ahead of the multer write; first ships in v2.1.0 (tag --contains head), i.e., after 2.0.1 and after the advisory.

BIC creation check: `git log --all --diff-filter=A -- 'packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/api/imageUpload/[context]multerFile[auth].js'` reports a2f514ad10073fb9ae164446f30205086151c095 (2023-01-03); its content at that commit contains `mkdirSync(join(CONSTANTS.MEDIAPATH, (request.params[0] || '').replace(/\s/g, '-')), { recursive: true })` and `cb(null, file.originalname.replace(/\s/g, '-'))`; the parent tree 4e518e617b76928656936e0048da852229acf24e has no imageUpload directory (introducer_parent_absent=true).
Version boundary: the BIC first ships in tag 1.0.0-rc.9 / v1.0.0; the vulnerable ordering persists through v2.0.0-v2.0.1 (the advisory's affected version); the fix first ships in v2.1.0.

AI-marker screening: `git log --format='%an <%ae>%n%cn <%ce>%n%B' -1 a2f514ad` shows only the human identity The Nguyen and the refactor message; the fix commit fc224b57 likewise carries no AI marker; no claude/copilot/anthropic/openai/generated/co-authored identity on the BIC object.

reasoning: Vulnerability first: the advisory describes unauthenticated uploads/directory creation on /api/images; in EverShop's phase-based middleware convention the [context]multerFile middleware executes (writing files and mkdirSync-ing directories) before the [auth] middleware runs, so 'access: private' does not protect the side effect — the fix's rename to [auth,validatePath]multerFile confirms the ordering is the defect. BIC choice: the 2023 'RESTful api implementation' commit a2f514ad created the imageUpload route with this exact phase-ordered middleware and the mkdirSync/upload side effects; the parent tree lacks the route entirely, making it the unique introducer. The 2025 fix fc224b57 is a pure rename/reorder of the same files (100% similarity for the moved files), confirming no earlier content change altered the flaw.
